scientific_integrity: Explicit C/O/V review of the inverse classification only. Forward formulas are not claimed as new; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Known mobility, known unequal diffusivities, known trace, SPD linear trap, ensemble stationary observables; no finite-sample estimation bound or nonlinear/underdamped generalization. Forward torque and angular-current formulas already appear in cited literature; priority of full joint inverse classification remains uncertain.
title: Sharp inverse identifiability and fold geometry of a two-temperature harmonic Brownian gyrator
